library(tidyverse)

  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",

## Functions

Start with Z-scores

```{r}
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

## Turn into function
```{r}
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers")
  }
  
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)

  return(z)
  
}
```

Does it work?
```{r, eval = FALSE}
z_scores(x_vec)

z_scores(rpois(40, lambda = 12))

```
